items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I would love to — but that’s not within my reach. It’s just something I can’t do.

ctx.x: Yeah. And then on flute I kind of always drifted a lot towards the Latin, that percussive, pungent sort of style. But I love playing obbligatos too, and ballads, and almost any era I guess. I liked to play the really really old tunes too, 30s tunes in a humorous way. And then on baritone I mean I leaned toward seeing it as a very lyrical, melodic instrument, rather than a punching out those — I like doing those too — honking out the notes. But for some reason I just find it a very —
Or the, was it Nick Brignola, who like he could play bop on the baritone like he was playing an alto.
Just like it was nothing, yeah, Nick and Pepper, oh my God they just — so marvelous, I would love to — but that’s not within my reach. It’s just something I can’t do.
